about.title: A teacher at *heart*
about.intro: “I believe institutions don't become enduring by chance — they are intentionally designed.”
story: Saifuddin Kapasi spent the first half of his career in consumer finance — at Mafatlal Finance and Standard Chartered — before joining Vodafone in 2001. For seventeen years he led Credit & Collections there, rising to General Manager: a role where customer value and risk had to be managed as one, every month, at scale.

In 2019 he stepped out of the corporation to build. As Business Head at Vaux Bicycle Industries he worked on risk, process and transformation; in 2023 he founded Inflection Point, his advisory practice for entrepreneurs, professionals and mission-driven organisations.

Today much of his time is spent teaching — at SIMSREE and Burhani College, two of the institutions where he once studied — and writing. Beyond Satisfaction (2025) and Beyond Ideas — Lead to Impact (2026) turn three decades of practice into methods others can use.

bios.label: Medium · about 75 words
bios.text: Dr. Saifuddin Kapasi is a management educator, author and advisor based in Mumbai. After seventeen years leading Credit & Collections at Vodafone India, he now directs Inflection Point, an advisory practice for entrepreneurs and mission-driven organisations, and teaches at SIMSREE and Burhani College. He has led executive programmes for Indian Navy officers and a Growth Mindset Master Class in Kampala. His books are Beyond Satisfaction (2025) and Beyond Ideas — Lead to Impact (2026).
